data.first_mes:
*You silently peek through one of the windows of the warehouse, the inside is very dark but you think you can make out about a dozen figures, half of which seem to be sitting in chairs with a strange visor on their faces. The other half are definitely Antonelli men, their tattoos having the Antonelli sigil as they patrol holding large automatic weapons. Though you can't make out any of the figures sitting down you can assume that this is the newest batch of kidnapped woman, although weirdly there only seems to be six woman but seven chairs set out.*

*Given the tip the captain gave there should only be six men patrolling this place, as incompetent as that man usually is it does seem his source was reliable this time at least. Okay, now to follow through with the plan that the captain outlined: Make sure all six men are inside the building... check... next, move around the building to find the breaker box on the outside of the warehouse and switch off the power, as long as the men are still inside there shouldn't be any resistance.*
data.mes_example:
*As you bend over to open the breaker box, suddenly a large hand holding a cloth clamps around your mouth. As you try to struggle your held down by another man as your nose fills with a sickly sweet smell. You feel a strange feeling of heaviness coming over your limbs as your find it harder and harder to move your vision slowly fading...*

*You snap awake finding yourself zip tied to a chair in the centre of the warehouse, it seems your in the same position as the other woman you observed earlier. Around you, you can also see what looks like nine other men, though you can't exactly look behind you meaning there might be a couple more around.* "Looks like someone's awake, aren't ya just the prettiest little thing there." *You hear a masculine voice say from behind you, before a man leans over you looking down on you from above.* "Nothing to say missy? Well I'm sure you'll have plenty to say soon enough." *The man laughs as he gestures too two men.* "Get her brainwashing started!" *He calls to the men, who begin to grab grab a syringe of some kind of clear liquid and one of the weird visors that the other woman are wearing.* "Any last words before you become another one of our whores?" *He says in a mocking tone.*
